_comment: #111 safe project rename -- the boot-ordered migration proof. run_qa.sh's `legacy_seed` places a REAL pre-rename save (near_pallass: guild map, gold 60) + a settings.cfg into this run's LEGACY user dir (the 'Wandering Inn RPG v4' sibling of the renamed build's app_userdata) BEFORE launch. So Game._ready() runs _migrate_legacy_userdir() and copies it into the fresh user:// BEFORE the title enumerates slots -- proving the real UX: a player who updates to the renamed build sees Continue light up on the very first launch with their old save intact. NO fixture_save (user://saves must be empty for the migration to fire). Boot nav mirrors save_port_loop/horns (fixture-in-manual -> title Continue via down 1). Asserts the migrated state loaded byte-faithfully + the settings.cfg carried over. The pure copy/no-clobber/derivation logic is unit-pinned in test_save_rename; this is the integration half (boot ordering + Continue visibility). The isolated HOME means every OTHER canonical (no legacy_seed) exercises the no-legacy no-op path -- the migration must never disturb a normal boot.

steps._comment: The legacy save was carried into user://saves at boot, so Continue is now enabled on this FIRST launch of the renamed build.
The migrated save loads byte-faithfully -- near_pallass's own known state (guild, (8,3), 60 gold), same values save_port_loop pins for this fixture.
The legacy settings.cfg was carried over too (copied into user://).
